effective: August 30, 2014, after Caldwell's reduction to 53 (4 p.m. ET); game_day_inactives set for Week 1 on August 31, 2014 with the captains
sources: The August 28 personnel packet's season depth chart baseline (Regular-season Week 1.md: Adams X, Thielen H, Hawkins Z; Lewis, Kelce, Jensen; Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Kreiter snapping; Hawkins returning kicks and punts with Hurns the second punt returner; Nicks back to X and Adams to Z only after medical clearance and a full practice week); the frozen August 27 Atlanta chart (Preseason_Games/Game_04/depth_chart.json) for every other order; the current roster for control and availability; the August 30 reduction (Roster_Decisions/final_roster_cuts.md) for the 53.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. The packet's baseline sets the starting eleven on offense, the snapper and the returners; the Atlanta chart's order is carried for everyone else, minus the players who left on August 30. A player out under a medical instruction is listed last in his group while out (Nicks, Hoskins) and is on the inactive list; his return to the order is Stone's decision on clearance under the packet's condition. The roles field carries the kernel roles (passer, placekicker, punt, kick_return, punt_return); Hurns is the second punt returner by Stone's instruction and is not given the kernel role, which the kernel reads as the first returner.

captains.structure: Six captains, three on offense (quarterback, offensive line, skill group) and three on defense (defensive line, linebackers, secondary), named by Stone with no player vote

game_day_inactives.note: Seven of the 53 are inactive for Week 1 at Philadelphia (46 dress; rules library R4). Hakeem Nicks (out, multi-week, projected return September 20, 2014) and Gator Hoskins (out, short, projected return September 16, 2014) are inactive by medical instruction. The other five are set by Stone's standing rule for the healthy inactives: the deepest healthy reserve on the chart in each of the five largest healthy position groups, never below a legal game-day unit, re-set each week; at August 31 those groups are the defensive backs (10: Malcolm Butler), the offensive line (9: Corey Linsley), the defensive line (8: Kasim Edebali), the linebackers (7: Todd Davis) and the receivers (5 healthy: Taylor Gabriel). A.J. Bouye cleared August 31, his projected date, and is active. Stone may replace any of the five in the Week 1 preparation; a week without a new list reuses the last one, minus players no longer controlled. The two reserve/injured players (Brate, Jackson) and the eight practice-squad players are not on the 53 and cannot appear here.
